sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2023 Mercedes-Benz S580, finished in Emerald Green with a Sienna Brown interior. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents in this Mercedes-Benz's brief past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this S580 carried an original MSRP of $147,850. Factory equipment includes the AMG Line and Warmth and Comfort packages, 20-inch AMG multispoke wheels, an Airmatic air suspension system, a 12.8-inch OLED touchscreen center display, soft-close doors, heated, ventilated, and power-adjustable dynamic front seats, heated, ventilated, and power-adjustable rear seats, an MBUX High End rear entertainment system, a Burmester surround sound system, and more as detailed below. Tinted windows are the only modification reported by the seller. Mercedes-Benz introduced the seventh-generation S-Class (called W223 internally) for the 2021 model year. Their updated flagship added even more technology than its predecessor and is characterized by a more streamlined exterior design. Production continues today. Power comes from a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, rated at 496 horsepower and 516 lb-ft of torque. Called M176 internally, the engine spins the rear wheels via a 9-speed automatic transmission.
